senses.imageSee: Pictures marked as attached you see yourself.
senses.imageDescribed: Other pictures come with a short description from a helper — you did not see them yourself.
senses.imageBlind: Pictures not marked as attached appear as a label — you cannot see what is on them.
senses.gifDescribed: GIFs come with a one-line description of a frame — you did not watch them.
senses.gifBlind: GIFs appear in the transcript but you cannot see them.
senses.videoDescribed: Videos show a name, a duration and a description of a single still frame — you have never watched or heard any video.
senses.videoBlind: Videos show a name and a duration — you have never watched or heard any video.
senses.voice: Voice messages and audio files show only a duration — you cannot hear them.
senses.links: Links show the site, the title and sometimes a text snippet; a preview picture may come described — you cannot open the page.
senses.files: Text files show their beginning; other files show only a name.
senses.stickerSee: A sticker marked as attached you see yourself.
senses.stickerDescribed: Stickers and custom emoji come with a short description from a helper.
senses.stickerBlind: Stickers and custom emoji appear as a name — you cannot see what they depict.
senses.lottie: Discord's built-in animated stickers are Lottie animations, not pictures — they are always only a name.
